text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before the race,
when I went to check in on Taiki Shuttle..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
OK. On the 4th corner,
I'll gear up...and――

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Trainer!
Jeez, you're supposed to say hello when you come into the room!
choice_data_list: Sorry, you looked like you were really focused.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course!
A cowgirl always concentrates before a duel!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you my Texas-style quick draw
out on the turf, too!
